rows.title: Lost in the Jungle — Jimmy Chin, Elizabeth Chai Vasarhelyi, & Juan Camilo Cruz [Review]
rows.comment: With a remarkable subject and captivating craft

rows.dek_lead: With a remarkable subject and captivating craft, it should be no surprise that Free Solo became one of the highest-earning documentaries of all time and won Best Documentary Feature at the 2018 Academy Awards.
